source_text: Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) in high-prevalence African settings demonstrate circumcision confers 50-60% efficacy in reducing heterosexual HIV acquisition in men, with pooled data from trials in South Africa, Kenya, and Uganda (involving over 10,000 participants) confirming sustained protection over 24-72 months follow-up, attributed to decreased viral entry via foreskin lesions. [96] [76]
